snippet.title: Sim Settlements 2 Announcement Trailer (Fallout 4)
snippet.description:
https://simsettlements2.com
AVAILABLE NOW!

Game capture & Editing - Pontus Johansson
https://twitter.com/_pontusjoh

Logo animation - Kalle Masth
https://kallemasth.se/

Music - Cerulean 3106 by Mark Petrie, licensed for use from https://www.audionetwork.com/

Narrator/Jake: Tom Schalk
Gunner: Jeff Wong
Aiden: River Kanoff


T-shirts Now Available! https://simsettlements.threadless.com

Join the cause on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/kinggath

Follow on social media for more news and extras:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/SimSettlements
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/simsettlements


Special Thanks

Galdavant and Kaigalinksi (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7mMBbDT3xo1KSGM9qazojw) for doing an amazing job editing all this video content!

RuinedWorld for the kinggath animated logo and JebRWocky for giving it sound effects!
